meta.note: Monday morning briefing. Two top stories: ZSI-Foster/Wesanco price increase takes effect today, Oct 26; A2 Global Q4 warning: Infineon orders repeatedly delayed, some ADI orders scheduled into 2028, Altera allocation only 40%~60%. LG R290 monobloc heat pump expansion, Shenling convertible bond fundraising for liquid-cooling capacity, Endeavour x Trevi waste-heat desalination, Chillventa record; this week's earnings window: JCI Oct 27 / Vertiv Oct 28 / Carrier Oct 29. Copper and aluminum carried over from Oct 23 (no new trading day over the weekend). Events library: 3 new events created (Daikin 2.5 MW CDU / US rebar October price increase / A2 Q4 semiconductor split warning), 3 timeline entries added (North America HVAC price increases / MLCC / DRAM), 60 events in total. Tier B batch 7: 1 hit (structural steel rebar).

daily_report.title: HVAC / Liquid-Cooling CDU Industry Intelligence Morning Briefing
daily_report.headline: ZSI-Foster/Wesanco price increase takes effect today, Oct 26; power and industrial-control distribution warning: Infineon orders repeatedly delayed, some ADI orders scheduled into 2028; LG R290 heat pump expansion, Shenling convertible bond fundraising for liquid-cooling capacity; this week's earnings window: JCI Oct 27, Vertiv Oct 28, Carrier Oct 29; Samsung MLCC lead times confirmed at 52 weeks across the board, TrendForce sees Q4 DRAM up another 20%.

hotspot_events.title: ZSI-Foster/Wesanco price increase takes effect today (Oct 26)
hotspot_events.heat_reason: A North America HVAC valves/fittings price increase landing on schedule; new orders from today are settled at the new prices, so in-transit order price terms must be checked immediately
hotspot_events.summary: The previously flagged North America HVAC valves/fittings price increase takes effect on schedule on Oct 26; Resideo air zoning on Oct 31 and Siemens DI China on Nov 1 are still pending.

hotspot_events.title: Power and industrial-control distribution warning: Infineon orders repeatedly delayed, some ADI orders scheduled into 2028
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Distributor delivery commitments are loosening: delays, price changes, and allocation cuts are appearing together, and lead-time risk is spreading from price increases to delivery itself
hotspot_events.summary: A2 Global Q4 update: Infineon orders repeatedly delayed, individual orders repriced just before delivery; Altera legacy customers receive only 40%~60% allocation; some ADI September orders are scheduled for delivery after September 2027, individual orders into 2028; TI prices on some product lines are still rising.

siphon_effects.change: TrendForce Oct 20 update: Q4 DRAM contract prices still seen up 20% quarter on quarter (growth slowing but not reversing); if Nvidia switches Rubin Ultra HBM from 12-Hi to 8-Hi, per-GPU memory capacity falls about 33%, the same wafer volume could supply about 50% more GPUs, but 8-Hi cost per Gb is expected to be 10%~20% higher than 12-Hi (2027); the 2027 HBM average price increase of +121% is unchanged

Samsung Electro-Mechanics lead times confirmed across the board: over 30 weeks on Sep 30 to 52 weeks in October, Yageo main products 30~52 weeks, shortage spreading to low-capacitance and automotive parts; Samsung Electro-Mechanics components division capacity utilization 91%, Philippines expansion not in mass production until after 2027

DC Market Insights Oct 21: liquid-cooled AI data centers use about $190,000 of pipes, fittings, valves, and insulation per MW, far above about $70,000 for air-cooled data centers; liquid-cooling secondary loops and rack manifolds grow from $177 million in 2025 to $1,581 million in 2035 (CAGR 24.47%)
Continuing: Kingboard eighth price-increase letter this year, +15%; Shengyi board / PP up another 10%~20% in early October; generic FR-4 lead time 6~8 weeks
siphon_effects.source: Carried over from morning briefing baseline

siphon_effects.change: Continuing: TrendForce Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices up 10~15% quarter on quarter (including HBM +15~20%), NAND +15~20%, enterprise SSD +23~28%
